title: Decision: TLS-safe mode returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE for all hash ops to keep wc_Sha256Copy working
description: wc_crypto2dev_cb():L1527-1529. For devIds registered via wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid*, all WC_ALGO_TYPE_HASH ops return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE immediately. This forces TLS 1.3 transcript hashing (which calls wc_Sha256Copy multiple times) to stay in software. The alternative — allowing hardware hash and implementing a kernel-side snapshot ioctl — would require a non-trivial kernel driver change. The current approach is minimal and correct. A contributor who adds a new hash algo to hardware support should not enable it for TLS devIds without implementing copy semantics.
